details.description: Titan Text Embeddings V2 is Amazon's second-generation text embeddings model on Amazon Bedrock, launched April 30, 2024. It converts a body of text into a numeric vector for retrieval and search, and lets callers choose an output vector size of 1,024, 512, or 256 dimensions. AWS's Bedrock model card lists it as an Active model with an 8,192-token input limit, and AWS documents it as optimized for English with multilingual support for over 100 additional languages.
advantages: Supports configurable output vector dimensions of 1,024 (default), 512, or 256, per AWS's Bedrock documentation.
AWS documents both a latency-optimized on-demand endpoint for retrieval and a throughput-optimized batch mode for indexing.
AWS's Bedrock model card lists this model's lifecycle status as Active, with no announced end-of-life date.
AWS documents multilingual support for over 100 languages in addition to English, for use in cross-lingual document search.
disadvantages: AWS's own documentation cautions that cross-language queries (for example, a Korean knowledge base queried in German) return sub-optimal results.
Does not support inference parameters such as maxTokenCount or topP, per AWS's documentation.
Text only: the model has no image or audio input, per AWS's Bedrock model card.
